rules.description: A new system-addressable state/field identity is materialized. Semantic support remains unadjudicated.
A downstream actor directly consumes an addressable object or descendant without requiring the original relay to be replayed.
A source-backed descendant is materialized in state/action structure.
An addressable object or descendant is consumed by multiple downstream actors/opportunities.
Accumulated support/reuse/dependency becomes structurally salient enough to nominate a bounded semantic-audit region.

non_claims: Candidate output is not semantic origin.
Pool candidacy is not epistemic correctness.
Exposure candidacy is not first structural support.
Hash lineage alone is not semantic adoption.
